title: Ethics Readiness of Artificial Intelligence: A Practical Evaluation Method
models_tested: AI facial sketch generator (using a Generative Adversarial Network)
Collaborative industrial robot (using AI-based navigation and computer vision)
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on a general framework for evaluating the ethical readiness of AI systems through a structured, iterative dialogue between ethics experts and technical teams.

measurement_description: The paper introduces Ethics Readiness Levels (ERLs), a method to track how ethical reflection is implemented in the design of AI systems. The benchmark measures general ethical considerations such as human autonomy, fairness, responsibility, privacy, and safety, but does not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion.
